sql: DISTINCT over supported projected column tuples; projected-output order then LIMIT; no DISTINCT ON
bounded case-sensitive text column LIKE '%literal%' (1-128 UTF8 bytes; no inner wildcards/escape)

media.layout: images/positive twelve-digit ID.jpg; no directory/file symlinks
media.response: identity plus exact JPEG bytes as hex JSON on stdout; no file writes
media.failure: source mismatch, missing/changed media, unsupported version, invalid/conflicting binding, nonregular/linked files, byte/time/output limits; complete JSON and exit0 required

ranked_text.optional_media: all five media-v1 fields; one asset per doc, same source SHA; text-only media=null
ranked_text.algorithm: bm25-positive-idf-v1; k1=1.2 b=.75; full corpus DF/dl/avgdl; tf*(k1+1)
ranked_text.analyzer: ascii-alnum-lower-v1; no stopwords/stemming; query tokens deduplicated
ranked_text.order: actual f64 score descending; exactly equal then doc_id ASCII ascending
ranked_text.preparation: prepare_text_corpus.py caller JSONL/local JPEG, no COCO/ZIP/preset dependency
ranked_text.response: original text, stable doc_id, score/TF/DF/dl/avgdl explanation and same-source media evidence identity
ranked_text.unsupported: unknown versions/layouts, duplicate doc IDs, NULL, nonASCII or unsupported controls (tab/CR/LF allowed), arbitrary analyzer/parameters, persistent index, relevance certification

exact_vector.binding: pinned whole feature SHA; same corpus SHA/exact docset/complete space; query same source and space
exact_vector.metric: f64 maxAbs scaled L2 normalization, cosine dot clamp [-1,1], canonical +0; zero/nonfinite reject
exact_vector.fusion: RRF k60; all BM25-positive ranks and full vector ranks before final TopK; absent BM25 contributes zero; raw scores kept separate
exact_vector.model_effectiveness: NOT_VERIFIED; numerical-fixture or caller external-declared space metadata, no inference/weights/semantic certification
exact_vector.compatibility: original query/search/media unchanged; no extra Parquet columns/types or dependencies

fixed_samples.selection: explicit unique DocID set/source SHA/seed u32; 64KiB/1..200 IDs; media-v1 corpus
fixed_samples.split: SHA256 ASCII guradb-sample-group-v1 LF seed-decimal LF asset-decimal LF; digest byte order then numeric asset ID; lowest group validation, rest train; at least two groups
fixed_samples.order: ASCII doc_id within each split; no automatic same-asset expansion
fixed_samples.validation: source/request SHA recheck; selected asset bytes/SHA checked; no pin/lease/GC; caller retains source/media
fixed_samples.external_consumer: actual PyTorch Dataset/DataLoader, two epochs, num_workers0/shufflefalse/drop_lastfalse; reader reproduction only, no training-result claim

local_views.identity: view ID = captured Parquet SHA256; request ID bound once to one source; replay never moves current backwards
local_views.publication: complete captured text/media v1 readiness before prepared catalog; atomic catalog publication; explicit public recover/status
unsupported: in-place v1 to v2 with existing views
late feature mutation under same ID
local_views.ownership: owned captured Parquet/JPEG retained until operator removes whole store; fixed old IDs never follow current; external source lifecycle not controlled

formats.2: full-feature ready query/search/media/vector/hybrid/sample, new empty store only

local_views.full_feature_identity: SHA256 ASCII guradb-view-features-v2 LF sourceSHA LF featureSHA LF; complete immutable feature bytes/docset/space/model/preprocess
local_views.full_feature_preparation: --features <JSONL> --features-sha256 <pin> during prepare; complete captured readiness before publish, no late dependency attachment
local_views.consumer: sample returns exact view_id; actual Torch reader fixes it once and every media call uses it across current refresh

local_preview.engine: Linux ARM64 ELF via existing fixed local Docker image Id

local_mcp.transport: stdio UTF8 single JSON per line
local_mcp.execution: same Rust executable readonly view CLI worker
local_mcp.media: concrete view ID mandatory; original bytes_hex and source/view identity

managed_dataset.scope: trusted single user; one local dataset; complete snapshot only
managed_dataset.identity: stable dataset ID, ordered schema SHA, immutable revision/view and input-bound durable operation
managed_dataset.read: existing view commands with returned exact view ID; old directconfig/v1/v2 unchanged
managed_dataset.recovery: public status/reconcile/retry; incomplete capture fails and cleans; complete owned ready can commit; old terminal replay never changes current
